versions.author: designer
versions.summary: Fish earn Stamps each time they Leap one slot upstream, swapping past bankside watchers. On the sixth Stamp a fish Spawns: it leaves for a reward and comes home to hand, and late cards copy, repeat or recycle those Spawns.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary: Old Kelt's kept fish now clear their Stamps so laps work, Bradán's text says how Little Jack's repeats work, and the Bear's once a turn includes the fight. A full passport now Spawns on its next Leap, so players see it coming, and Fish-Pass Trout gives its fish a fight buff so it earns a pick.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
